column1: # Extra devices a lab Pi can play (#155), besides the roles camera, server and hub (whose
# default-on rows in services.tsv are their presets). Tab-separated:
# preset name, the services it turns on (comma-separated, "-" for none), description.
# Any service runs on any Pi; `sudo labctl preset NAME` turns these on and the rest off.

column3: Network printer: anyone can send it print jobs, and it answers SNMP
No-name smart bulb: an open MQTT broker, UPnP, and no vendor or name
Home storage box: folder sharing and old FTP
Nothing on: turn on any services you like from the manager or with labctl break
